tactical_thesis: Advance Midnight's initial deployment by delaying Friston until just before lower-central contact. Use earlier northern clearance to transfer the upper outer lane to Spot, then redeploy Midnight centrally. Keep Melantha permanently on the lower outer lane until combat ends. Place Ansel north, Hibiscus south and Steward north: Spot supports the northern shared barrage, while southern Hibiscus receives isolated artillery impacts. Steward subsequently rotates through central armor clearance and western restraint clearance. This is a complete, unsimulated current-model hypothesis with explicit clearance and survival dependencies.
